integrity: The necessity proof supplies an explicit adversarial proxy assignment with an exactly uniform null p-value; the sufficiency proof uses only stochastic dominance implied by super-uniformity. The packaged computation is corroborative. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The closed-form theorem is restricted to two proxy bins, a nonquery output fixed at \(1\), ordered query probabilities and queried multipliers, and \(b_2\le1\).
It is a single-hypothesis super-uniformity result, not a new multiple-testing error-control theorem.
The computation checks exact examples and envelope algebra but does not replace the analytic universal proof.
Targeted searches and full-text comparisons found no equivalent statement, but terminology outside the active-testing literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp two-bin frontier for active p-values under arbitrary proxy dependence
